headline: Natore: Police constable and wife arrested for cutting off child's finger
summary: A 7-year-old boy's finger was partially severed in the incident. The suspects have been sent to jail.
details: A police constable and his wife have been arrested in Natore for allegedly cutting off a portion of a 7-year-old boy's right-hand finger.
The arrests follow a formal case filed against the couple regarding the brutal attack on the child.
Authorities have taken the suspects into custody and subsequently sent them to jail.
The incident has sparked significant concern over the violence inflicted upon the minor.
